g.title: scan
g.text: explicit allow digest; warnings stay separate

g.title: codec
g.text: canonical UTF-8 path order + base64 JSONL

g.title: mirror
g.text: verify tree / bytes / public visibility / count

g.title: pushunknown
g.text: retain local mirror; remote outcome unverified

g.title: subscribe->header
g.text: cache data for separate indexing caller / later scan

g.title: keep
g.text: no success inferred from another source

g.title: unseal
g.text: nonce invariant + relative paths + duplicate/count checks

g.title: add
g.text: reject collision -> clone cache; indexing is separate

g.title: listing
g.text: communityList: directory enumeration + SQLite source counts
CLI display / Web escaped HTML and mtime

g.title: remove
g.text: dry-run OR delete cache directory -> delete source DB rows
FS + DB are not one transaction; partial failure can remain

g.title: cacheonly
g.text: update cache; tell user to index separately

g.title: clipull
g.text: CLI pull: communityPull -> reindex own + community
write digest -> finally close owned DB

g.title: mcppull
g.text: server-owned DB; return pulled / indexed; no digest write
